atoms.b: Many goods have special ((codes ++labels)) on their packaging to show customers that they have been produced fairly.
This means that the companies making them follow ((local ++global)) fair trade laws, which were invented to make global trade more ethical.

hint.text: Being ethical means acting in a way that is responsible, fair and kind.
hint.label: Ethical

atoms.b: When products have these labels, it means that the people making or growing them are treated ((badly ++equally)), work in ((dangerous ++safe)) conditions and receive a ((++fair_pay haircut)).

atoms.a: Which of these are protected by fair trade laws?

instruction.text: When manufacturing goods, companies can also make ethical decisions. Match each action to the correct image.

hint.text: Doing something sustainably means using Earth’s resources in a way that people in the future will still be able to use them.
hint.label: Sustainable

feedback.finish: These actions minimise damage to the environment and encourage sustainable trading in the future.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Making and transporting goods burns fossil fuels, which contributes to climate change and global warming. The measure of this damage is known as a carbon footprint.
Companies can reduce their carbon footprint by using renewable energy to power their factories, machines and vehicles.
As customers, we can help by buying goods that are produced sustainably, use recycled packaging, and that are made locally with lower food miles.

hint.text: Food miles is a term used to measure the distance food travels from where it is grown to where it is sold and eaten. Generally, food that travels less distance is better for the environment.
hint.label: Food miles

atoms.a: Which of these contributes to global warming?
Which of these can reduce the carbon footprint of trade?
Which two options are better for the environment?

finish.text: Along the entire supply chain, companies can act to make the making, transporting and selling of goods fairer and more environmentally friendly.
